title: Token Clock — Your AI Bill Now Depends on What Time You Run It
tagline: DeepSeek's peak/off-peak API pricing goes live at 16:00 UTC on 16 Aug 2026 — output tokens up to 1,100% more expensive, and half price outside two UTC windows. Map your daily traffic onto those bands in your own timezone, see your peak exposure, and watch deferrable work shift into off-peak. 100% in your browser, no API key.
